The city of Chongqing is essentially built into a mountain. Due to its terrain the city needed manpower to transport its goods from place to place, since vehicles couldn’t tackle the hills. The bang bang men, named after the bamboo sticks placed along their shoulders used to carry up to 50kg on each side, were once 500,000 strong. Today there are less than 2000 of them.
